board_identity: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK — one pick per game
unified_rule: ONE pick per game: (1) if the champion has a qualifying PLAY on the game (clears its +EV gate) that IS the pick; (2) else if the v4 model grid has a playable lean (clears the +EV gate + 0.01 conviction floor) that is the pick; (3) else if the grid has an EXPANDED-band lean (2026-07-24 on: full +EV gate + conviction 0.0075-0.010 — the measured near-miss band, 104-78-4 / +15.7% ROI walk-forward backtest) that is the pick, flagged expanded_band with REGULAR display stars from the one ladder (mostly 2*), 0.5u stake rail, graded separately under record.expanded_band and folded into by_star_tier with includes_expanded_n; (4) else the game shows its best lean as a PASS (never a bet). One 0-5 score + star ladder (frozen v3.2 percentile score; v3.3 full 1-5 display bands — top ~10% of playable scores -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; `certified` is a separate boolean, false everywhere today), shared by both sources; one record, graded once per game against finals. `source` is diagnostic only — the UI renders champion- and model-sourced picks identically.
score_reference_version: v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25: full 1-5 display scale — stars = frozen percentile bands of the unchanged v3.2 continuous score over playable rows: top ~10% -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest playable -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean, no longer the 5* gate)

star_cutoffs.version: v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25: full 1-5 display scale — stars = frozen percentile bands of the unchanged v3.2 continuous score over playable rows: top ~10% -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest playable -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean, no longer the 5* gate)
star_cutoffs.basis: v3.3 percentile display bands of the (unchanged) v3.2 continuous score over ALL playable rows of the season replay (v4 totals grid + champion_v2 2026 backfill). Frozen ABSOLUTE score thresholds for live serving — recomputed only when the replay payload regenerates (nightly), never per-day. The -EV floor is hard: non-playable rows stay 1* regardless of score. `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean — no display band claims certification.
star_cutoffs.bands: v3.3 percentile display bands of the continuous v3.2 score over playable rows: score >= cutoff_5 -> 5* (top ~10%), >= cutoff_4 -> 4* (next ~25%), >= cutoff_3 -> 3* (next ~35%), else 2*; 1* = non-playable (hard -EV floor). `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean — no star band claims certification.

score_basis.recipe: logit(p_cal) = logit(p_mkt) + s * (logit(p_our) - logit(p_mkt)); s fit by penalized IRLS with identity prior s~N(1, 1/25), clamped to [0, 1.25]; NO intercept (the layer refuses to learn the trailing window's over/under rate); expanding-window walk-forward fit on the engine's own graded FG-totals rows (2026 replay pre-block + served graded ledger, y = final vs judged line, pushes/voids dropped, strictly date < D); refit per serve date, frozen first-fit-wins; inactive (identity) below 300 rows / 10 graded days
score_basis.scope: v4 model-grid FULL-GAME TOTALS our_prob only — champion-stream picks, spread/ML/F5 rows, the EV-gate math and every score/star band cutoff are untouched; they simply receive the calibrated probability
score_basis.note: SCORE BASIS CHANGE (activation-dated 2026-07-27, forward only): the model grid's served probability passes through a walk-forward market-anchored calibration map fitted on strictly-past graded picks before the (unchanged) EV gate and score pipeline. Locked picks, graded history and every past score/record are NEVER restated. A calibrated row can never flip sides — only its stated conviction changes. This does NOT create edge and no edge is claimed: it makes the confidence number mean what it says.

signals_note: signals are contextual factors aligned with the lean, not causal attribution — the model is market-anchored and its number is not derived from these factors

expanded_band.rule: model-grid rows with the FULL +EV gate (ev >= 0.015, unchanged) and conviction 0.0075 <= |our_prob - market_devig| < 0.010 are playable 2* fills from the activation date forward — the exact measured near-miss band; every adjacent band (conviction 0.0050-0.0075, any EV-gate relaxation) measured as a loser and stays PASS

backtest.window: 2026-03-25..2026-07-23 (walk-forward rows only; one game per day-game, best-EV wall; graded vs settled finals at the row's own executable price)
backtest.note: BACKTEST (would-have) record — NOT a served record. The served expanded-band record accrues from EXPANDED_BAND_START under record.by_star_tier['2_expanded'], separately from core 2*.

expanded_band.rails: expanded_band=true on the pick; REGULAR display stars from the one v3.3 ladder (mostly 2* — no separate display row; record.by_star_tier carries includes_expanded_n per tier); 0.5u stake regardless of display stars; graded separately (record.expanded_band.served_record); a core playable row always beats an expanded row on the same game; history is never retroactively promoted

engine.model: residual_spread_v1 (rolling engine full-game spread cells — the same live engine that serves totals; direction only)
engine.basis: unproven spread stream — served as an honest LEAN only. The direction is the live model's read of the run line; the pre-pivot spread machinery was adjudicated NOT deployable (no cell cleared matched baselines + Brier + CLV + monotonicity), and the run-line simulator engine verdict (2026-07-27) came back BLOCKED — the margin fitness gate failed and the de-vigged run-line market beat every declared arm. Nothing here is a bet.
engine.upgrade_path: UPGRADE PATH: a future run-line engine that passes its margin fitness gate with a surviving arm and real economics can flip the stream to sim_pricing (P(cover) from a validated joint margin distribution, +EV gate at real per-side prices, max 2*). The 2026-07-27 DERIV_RUNLINE_MARGIN_REPORT verdict was BLOCKED (prereg K1: margin fitness gate failed — no home-field advantage in the engine; and every declared arm, including the no-sim control, lost to the de-vigged market on Brier), so lean_only stands. The flip is explicit and human-signed (state/spread_engine_mode.json) — never automatic, never regex-parsed off a research report.

analysts.name: VEGA · The Market Reader

analysts.engine: the champion engine (champion_v2) — the only stream with the live record; the desk reads its outputs, never touches it
analysts.conviction_basis: the champion's own probability for its stated side (its historical gate evidence, not a walk-forward calibration map)

analysts.name: ATLAS · The Physicist
analysts.persona_line: Builds the game from first principles — 20,000 Monte Carlo runs of every plate appearance, park, weather and umpire included. Trusts the simulation, not the crowd.
analysts.engine: the physical run simulator stream (sim_stream.py) — per-wall priced, write-once, its own lean ledger
analysts.conviction_basis: P(side) from the sim's walk-forward-calibrated run distribution (the s5 mean map)

analysts.name: NOVA · The Quant

analysts.engine: the v4 model grid stream (residual engine + prob_calibration) — the current model source of the unified pick
analysts.conviction_basis: the grid's served probability — walk-forward calibrated (prob_calibration) on rows from 2026-07-27 forward; raw model prob earlier

analyst_desk_spec.per_game_fields: games[].analysts = [{key, name, persona_line, side (over|under|null), p_over, conviction (0-1, P(stated side), calibrated where the engine has a calibration — see each analyst's conviction_basis), locked, wall, has_row, take, take_kind}] — ALWAYS all four, in `order`; null side = no read yet (pre-wall or no view; has_row=false means the engine has not priced the game at all). ANALYST VOICES (2026-07-30): `take` is a 1-2 sentence line in the persona's voice rendered FROM THAT ENGINE'S OWN ROW DATA (analyst_takes.py template libraries — deterministic per analyst x game, byte-stable across regenerations); every number in a take is validator-checked to exist in the source row — nothing fabricated, ever. take_kind is standard | dissent (the lone voice against >= 2 opposing reads argues back) | no_read. LIVE ATLAS (2026-07-30): on LIVE games the atlas entry gains {live_p_over, live_state_note, as_of} — the certified conditional simulator re-pricing P(over the pregame line) from the actual game state, ONLY inside its certified fitness buckets (v4/serve/live_atlas.py); outside them live_p_over is null and the note says the desk is watching. DISPLAY ONLY, forever: never graded, never a bet, never touches any record. games[].consensus = {n_over, n_under, n_no_read, state UNANIMOUS|MAJORITY|SPLIT|PENDING, majority_side, spread: {n_home, n_away, n_no_read, state, majority_side, voices, note}} — UNANIMOUS requires all FOUR to agree; MAJORITY is a strict majority of those with reads; SPLIT is a tie of reads; PENDING is no reads. The spread dimension counts the desk's margin voices only (ATLAS + NOVA); VEGA and SCOUT have no margin view and are honest no-reads there. FULL COVERAGE (2026-07-30): every entry also carries {vs_line (the EXACT line that engine was priced against — render it as 'ATLAS: OVER 8.5 (priced vs 8.5)'), vs_line_is_pregame_line (bool|null vs the LOCKED pregame line), coverage_expanded, coverage_kind (market_signal|engine_backfill|null), coverage_activation, low_conviction, conviction_calibrated}. A coverage entry is a FORCED-COVERAGE read: the engine had no native row, so the desk filled the slot — VEGA from its own market microstructure (line move / sharp divergence / book-median de-vig, conviction capped at 0.53), ATLAS and SCOUT from their own engines run on the latest arrived pregame wall. take_kind gains `coverage` for those. Coverage reads grade in their OWN ledger (record.coverage) and NEVER enter record.analysts. games[].pregame_line = {total, total_price_over, total_price_under, run_line, run_line_price_home, run_line_price_away, book, captured_at, wall, locked_at, is_locked, total_open, total_move, p_over_devig, n_books, first_captured_at, source, note} | null — the market state at the last wall before first pitch, WRITE-ONCE and immutable from the moment locked_at is stamped. games[].line_now = {total, pregame_total_compared, total_price_over, total_price_under, book(null), comparison_basis('book_consensus_median'), same_basis:true, same_book_check {book, pregame_total, total, move, total_price_over, total_price_under} | null, n_books, as_of, source, market:'full_game_total', moved_vs_pregame, move, max_plausible_move, display_only:true, note} | null — the CURRENT read of the SAME full-game pregame totals market the locked line came from, so a pregame move never mutates the locked line. FOUR RAILS the frontend can rely on: (1) it is ALWAYS the same market — in-play/remaining-runs totals are never a source; (2) it is NULL for any game that has started (after first pitch there is no pregame market to compare to — render the locked line alone); (3) books are NEVER mixed and the headline ALWAYS reconciles with what is on screen: both sides are the same consensus-median basis, so `move` is exactly `line_now.total - pregame_line.total` and `pregame_total_compared` always equals `pregame_line.total` (the anchor book's own move is corroboration only, in `same_book_check`); (4) a comparison implying a move larger than `max_plausible_move` runs, or one where the same-book check moves the opposite way, is refused and logged in payload.line_now_audit, never shipped. So 'MARKET MOVED' should only ever render off a real, plausible, arithmetically-reconciling `move`. games[].live_progress = {status:'in_progress', inning, half, outs, away_score, home_score, runs_so_far, pregame_total, runs_vs_pregame_total, runs_still_needed_for_over, innings_elapsed, pace_runs_per_inning, projected_final_runs, p_hit_now, p_hit_side, p_hit_side_basis, p_hit_certified, p_hit_basis, p_hit_buckets, p_hit_note, live_p_over, as_of, display_only:true, note} | null — p_hit_now is the probability the PREGAME pick still cashes and is populated ONLY inside the live simulator's CERTIFIED buckets (p_hit_certified true); outside them it is null. Every live number is display-only and touches no record. games[].diamondedge = the synthesis frame: the served pick's mirror (side/line/stars/score/price/result/...) + {consensus_state, action PLAY|LEAN|AVOID, action_before_pattern, pattern_downgraded, confidence_rank (3=PLAY,2=LEAN,1=AVOID), rationale_line, pattern, pattern_line, synthesis_config_version, spread_call, predicted_score, chief, note}. games[].diamondedge.chief = THE CHIEF (2026-07-30), the PREGAME synthesis: {scope:'pregame', ou_call: {side, line, line_is_locked_pregame, desk_votes, engine_pick_status, engine_pick_side, stars, is_bet}, spread_call, predicted_score, consensus_state, action, confidence_rank, pattern, pattern_line, pattern_downgraded, rationale_line, synthesis_config_version, note}. The chief's language and its confidence ordering are PATTERN-AWARE (record.patterns): on a unanimous game where unanimity measures below 50% the chief says so and the displayed action moves DOWN one rung. It can only ever move DOWN — a PASS never becomes a PLAY. spread_call = {side home|away|null, side_team, line, home_line, rationale_line, voices, is_bet:false, note} | null. predicted_score = {away, home, source:'ATLAS', p_home_win, wall, note} | null — per-team medians from the sim's joint distribution; display only, graded nowhere.

action_vocabulary.PLAY: underlying PICK + the desk is UNANIMOUS behind its side
action_vocabulary.LEAN: underlying PICK with a friendly majority, or reads still pending
action_vocabulary.AVOID: the desk is split or leans against the pick, or there is no qualifying pick — displayed as the desk passing. CONTINUITY: an underlying pick still exists and still grades; AVOID is presentation only.

analyst_desk_spec.record_fields: record.analysts = {order, records: {vega|atlas|nova|scout: {n, win, loss, push, hit_rate, roi, units, last10 (oldest->newest W/L/P), activation_date, is_betting_record, basis, profile_headline (the MEASURED one-liner for the roster card — the analyst's top surviving characteristic, or the null statement when nothing survived), profile_has_characteristic, profile_ref}}, note} — vega/nova live-only activation-dated betting records (identical numbers to by_strategy champion/model_v4 headlines); atlas/scout graded lean ledgers. record.consensus_history = {by_state: {UNANIMOUS|MAJORITY|SPLIT: {n, win, loss, push, hit_rate, roi}}, n_games_with_all_four_graded, note} — sparse until all four have history; honest n, no conclusions at small n. NIGHTLY RECAP (2026-07-30): record.desk_recap = the latest written recap {date, winner (analyst of the night: best graded record, ties to higher avg conviction), lines (per-analyst W-L), best_call/worst_call ({analyst, game_pk, matchup, line, conviction} — the line is grounded in the actual graded row + the real final total and validator-checked), consensus_note, desk_verdict_line} | null; record.desk_recaps = {latest, history (last 14 written dates, newest last), n_written, note} — write-once per date, computed from graded ledgers only, never restated. RIVALRY (2026-07-30): record.head_to_head = {pairs: [{pair, names, n_disagreements, wins: {key: n}, pushes, n_both_graded, line}], note} — disagreement scoreboards over games where both analysts graded and their sides differed. record.weekly_standings = {week_start, this_week (Mon-Sun in progress), last_week (completed), analyst_of_the_week (from the last completed week only), note}. THE PATTERN ENGINE (2026-07-30): record.patterns = {updated, desk_activation, live_era, reconstructed_era, highlights[3], honest_note, computed_from, status}. Each era carries {era, n_games, date_range, by_family, by_config, by_dissenter, by_split_pair, pairwise, note}; every row is {n, n_decided, win, loss, push, hit_rate, hit_ci95 (EXACT Clopper-Pearson), fade: {hit_rate, hit_ci95}} plus its config meta (family / dissenter / over_pair / under_pair / side). by_config keys are 'UNANIMOUS_4|<side>', 'MAJORITY_3-1|dissent=<analyst>|<side>' and 'SPLIT_2-2|over=<a>+<b>'. `fade` is the CONTRARIAN read — what betting AGAINST that configuration would have done. pairwise is {'<a>~<b>': {agree, disagree, note}} for all six pairs. highlights[] are {era, key, n, hit_rate, hit_ci95, fade_hit_rate, significant, line} with a plain-English `line` that always states n and the era. THE TWO ERAS ARE NEVER SUMMED. THE MEASURED ANALYST PROFILE (2026-07-31): record.analyst_profiles — THE MEASURED ANALYST PROFILE. What each analyst has been MEASURED to do, replacing written prose on the roster page. Recomputed nightly off v4/models/analyst_lab/runs/latest.json. SHAPE: {status ('ok'|'not_computed_yet'|'no_lab_run'|'error'), updated (iso8601 UTC|null), order (the four analyst keys in display order), headline, family, profiles, source, honest_note}. ITERATE `order`, NOT `Object.keys(profiles)` — the payload round-trips through Postgres jsonb, which normalises object key order (by key length, then bytewise), so `profiles` arrives as nova/vega/atlas/scout no matter what was written. `order` is an ARRAY and is the display order. headline = {line (RENDER THIS ABOVE THE ROSTER — when nothing survived correction it states the null result and that IS the finding), any_characteristic (bool), status ('characteristics'|'no_measurable_specialism'|'not_computed_yet'), what_this_block_is}. family = {size (how many cells were tested — the multiplicity the headline is corrected for), method, test, min_cell_n, n_cells_ci_excludes_baseline (UNCORRECTED diagnostic — NEVER render it as a count of strengths), n_cells_bh_significant, smallest_p_two_sided (a number for checkability, NEVER a sentence), any_characteristic, note}. profiles[key] = {key, short, baseline {n, win, loss, hit_rate, hit_ci95, span}, baseline_line (one sentence with its own interval inside), n_cells_tested, axes_measured, any_characteristic, headline (THE per-analyst lead — the top characteristic's sentence, or, when nothing survived, 'Nothing yet distinguishes where this analyst is strong; the axes all sit within noise of its own baseline'), characteristics[], strengths[], weaknesses[], n_cells_ci_excludes_baseline, note}. characteristics[] is ORDERED BY EVIDENCE (smallest p, then largest n) and NEVER by effect size; strengths/weaknesses are the same rows split by direction. Each row = {analyst, axis (display label), axis_key (raw column), cell, n, win, loss, hit_rate, hit_ci95 (EXACT Clopper-Pearson 95%), baseline_hit_rate (the SAME analyst's complement, not 50% and not another analyst), baseline_n, delta_vs_baseline, direction ('strong'|'weak'|'flat'), ci_excludes_baseline (uncorrected), p_two_sided (EXACT two-sided Fisher vs its own complement), test, bh_significant, roi_flat110 (flat -110 convention, diagnostic only), line (the rendered sentence — the interval is INSIDE it; render `line` verbatim, never a bare hit_rate), selection}. THREE RENDERING RAILS. (1) ONLY rows in `characteristics` may be shown as something an analyst does; every one of them carries bh_significant true by construction. (2) A row's `line` already contains n and the exact interval — do not strip it down to a percentage. (3) When any_characteristic is false the profile is NOT empty: render profiles[key].headline, which states the null. definitions.label: The DiamondEdge Pick

GRADING: the row's own settled result at the real executable per-side price it was served at, on the line locked at first pitch; pushes return the stake and leave the ROI denominator. HEADLINE COVERS: served picks from 2026-07-20 (the day the hybrid went live) forward only.

definitions.label: Champion engine
definitions.what: The champion engine's own totals play — its frozen pipeline plus the +EV gate at the real per-side price. It only speaks on games where its trigger fires; on every other game it has no view at all.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the champion engine itself rated PLAYABLE and that settled — one row per game (its highest-score playable wall). definitions.label: V4 model grid
definitions.what: The v4 model grid's best playable totals lean on the game (+EV gate at the real price AND at least 1 point of model-vs-market disagreement).
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game where the v4 model grid had a playable totals row that settled — one row per game (core playable preferred over an expanded-band row, then highest score). This DELIBERATELY INCLUDES games the champion also played, which record.by_source.model does NOT: by_source counts only the games the model FILLED after the champion passed, so the two numbers differ and neither is wrong. definitions.label: Physical run simulator
definitions.what: A fully-physical Monte Carlo of the game — every plate appearance drawn from empirical base-out transition tables tilted to the two lineups, starters, bullpens, park, weather and umpire as of each decision wall (T-24h through T-1h, re-priced as inputs firm up, each wall written once), with home-field advantage on, 20,000 games simulated — priced into P(over the posted total). strategies_spec.overlap_note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING STRATEGIES. (1) THEY OVERLAP: the same game appears in more than one stream — expanded_band is a strict SUBSET of model_v4, and unified is whichever of champion/model_v4 won that game. spread_stream.basis: POPULATION: every game the run-line stream served from its 2026-07-27 activation forward — one graded row per game (the latest locked wall), stream-stamped rows only. A DIFFERENT MARKET from everything above: it never overlaps, sums with, or competes against any totals record. GRADING: the same board rails as totals — locked at first pitch, graded overnight at the REAL locked per-side run-line price, write-once, pushes returned. spread_stream.note: NEW — graded from day one. GRADED LEAN LEDGER — NOT A BETTING RECORD. The spread stream is live in lean_only mode: every game's stated run-line lean is locked at first pitch and graded against the final at the real locked price, in public, from the 2026-07-27 activation forward — but a lean is not a bet, no units are ever suggested, and no edge is claimed. The record starts 0-0-0 and accrues only from days the stream actually served. It is never added to, or compared against, the totals record.

simulator.label: Physical run simulator
simulator.what: A fully-physical Monte Carlo of the game — every plate appearance drawn from empirical base-out transition tables tilted to the two lineups, starters, bullpens, park, weather and umpire as of each decision wall (T-24h through T-1h, re-priced as inputs firm up, each wall written once), with home-field advantage on, 20,000 games simulated — priced into P(over the posted total). The lean that grades is the latest wall locked at first pitch. Shown for transparency: on full-game totals it statistically TIES the market (its median lands within ~0.02 runs of the posted line; blend-vs-market p=0.28), so it is a tracked voice, never a bet.

live_ledger.what: the v4 grid's own live graded ledger — the rows the board served

simulator.basis: POPULATION: every game the physical simulator priced from its 2026-07-28 activation forward — ONE graded row per game. The sim re-prices at each decision wall as inputs firm up (T-24h through T-1h from 2026-07-30; T-3h only before that), every wall write-once, and the row that grades is the LATEST wall locked at first pitch (earlier walls settle 'superseded', kept for audit, never counted). Sim-stamped rows from the stream's OWN ledger only. GRADING: the stated lean (the side implied by the sim's P(over) vs the market's) graded against the settled final at the LOCKED posted line, overnight, append-only — but this is a LEAN LEDGER, not a betting record: no units are ever staked, is_bet is false on every row, and stars are hard-capped at 1*. HEADLINE COVERS: 2026-07-28 forward only — the stream starts 0-0-0, and the sim round's backtest (a statistical TIE with the market) is evidence about the engine, never credit.
simulator.note: A fully-physical model of baseball whose median independently lands on Vegas's number — shown for transparency, graded in public, no edge claimed. GRADED LEAN LEDGER — NOT A BETTING RECORD. The simulator prices every game's posted total from a full physical simulation and states which side its probability implies; it re-prices at each decision wall as inputs firm up (T-24h through T-1h, every wall write-once, never revised), and the lean that grades is the LATEST wall locked at first pitch — one graded row per game, graded against the final in public, from the 2026-07-28 activation forward — but a lean is never a bet, no units are ever staked, and no edge is claimed: the engine's validated result is that it TIES the market. The record starts 0-0-0 and is never added to, or compared against, the totals or spread records.

record.by_strategy_note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING STRATEGIES. (1) THEY OVERLAP: the same game appears in more than one stream — expanded_band is a strict SUBSET of model_v4, and unified is whichever of champion/model_v4 won that game. Their records are NOT additive: do not sum n, units or ROI across strategies, and do not read 'four strategies' as four independent bets. (2) NO POST-HOC PICKING: choosing whichever stream currently looks best is not a strategy — with four overlapping streams on a few dozen graded picks, one of them looks good by construction. The only number that ever described a real bankroll is the served unified pick from its activation date forward. (3) LIVE vs BACKTEST are kept apart on purpose: each strategy's headline n/W-L-P here is its LIVE-SERVED picks only; reconstructed / walk-forward / would-have measurements sit in `backtest`, are labeled, and are never added to the live number. `combined_view` restates the union ONLY because the older published blocks (record.overall, record.by_source) report it — it is not a live record. (4) Sample sizes here are small. None of this is an edge claim.

patterns.honest_note: THE PATTERN TABLE IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. Every row carries its n and an EXACT binomial (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval; a hit rate whose interval straddles 50% is a coin flip no matter how far from 50% the point estimate looks. The two eras are computed and shown separately and are NEVER summed: `reconstructed_era` is the walk-forward reconstruction of the four engines before the desk existed, `live_era` is the desk's own graded ledgers from 2026-07-30 forward (it starts empty and accrues). The reconstructed era's 2022-2023 slice sits inside the DEV window the four recipes were selected on, so it flatters the analysts relative to true out-of-sample; `by_season_family` keeps that slice visible instead of pooling it away. Betting confidence remains solely the champion EV gate + the star system — nothing in this table gates, sizes or creates a bet.

analyst_profiles.honest_note: THE PROFILE IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BET RULE. Each analyst is described by where its OWN graded history differs from its OWN baseline — never against another analyst, never against 50%. Every cell on every axis is one test, this surface renders hundreds of them at once, and under a pure null the most extreme of them is GUARANTEED to look striking; so a cell may be called a characteristic ONLY if it survives a single Benjamini-Hochberg pass across the WHOLE rendered family (all analysts x all axes x all cells) at q=0.1. Among survivors the order is by EVIDENCE (smallest p, then largest n) and never by how big the effect looks. When nothing survives, the profile says so — that is the honest result, and it is worth more than a cherry-picked percentage. Three of the four analysts' histories reach back into the 2022-2023 DEV window their own recipes were selected on, so those seasons FLATTER them relative to true out-of-sample; the `season` axis keeps that visible instead of pooling it away. Prices are a flat -110 throughout (the history carries no per-row price), so every number here is a HIT RATE question, not an ROI claim. Betting confidence remains solely the champion EV gate + the star system — nothing in this block gates, sizes or creates a bet.
